verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents and hosts an official remote MCP server (mcp.workos.com) that lets MCP-compatible AI agents act on the WorkOS workspace, secured via AuthKit's OAuth authorization server, and a live probe confirms the endpoint exists and correctly gates sessions behind auth. This is a first-party, production MCP server offering, not just client-side integration. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on report of a successful agent connection beyond the vendor docs and auth-gate probe.
